proximityInsight.exampleText: Eg: a top-ranked day on 13-Mar-20 landed within 3 days of a sharp fall on 16-Mar-20

bestDays.headlineSummary: If you missed the 15 best days in the analysis period, your portfolio lost 2/3rd of its value compared to staying fully invested.

missingBestQuarter.headline: Returns lost from missing the best quarter over the latest three-year window was ~6% annualized

volatility.headline: Medium risk with 17.6% annualised volatility; typical daily move ±0.78%

summary.headline: 14 of 14 calendar years (100%) printed a new all-time high NAV — growth naturally spends much of its time at fresh peaks.

postAthReturns.headline: The average 1-year return from investing in ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth on an all-time high day is ~13%.

athDeclineOutlook.headline: In 66% of instances where ICICI Prudential US Bluechip Equity Fund - Direct Plan -  Growth reached an all-time high, it never fell 10% below that level — further declines came from much higher levels.
